historic_stall.why_unknown: The test output was block-buffered: lines arrived in chunks of about 130 sharing one timestamp, and the last delivered chunk arrived about 22 s after XCTest wrote its first line. The last delivered line is a buffer boundary, not the stalled test. The named test has no suspension point. The stall lies in roughly the next buffer of tests, which was lost when the job was cancelled.
historic_stall.not_a_budget_overrun: Both runs moved at the same pace, and the remaining suite normally takes about 90 s.
